why: Expression cycle 17 (docs/v3/cycles/expression-17.md) lost 23 of its 46 round-0 points to lessons the kit could already do (class `skill`), two P2 items among them: n86 stood a 90-day-old weekly check against nothing, and its 'of all' pills are shares of the whole, not a baseline (F3 1, .37); n82 drew five measure cells, a grid of five records one per measure, with no table view, which cards.md:60 and the owner's self-check name (R4 1, .15). X1 (word economy) lost a point on 6 of 6 cases (cycle 16: 5 of 6) although every builder wrote the read-aloud pass v3-expr-16-skill made cut what it finds: five of six passes named the repeat and kept it under a reason ('the base, not the window' n81, 'kit forces' n82, 'one fact on two slots' n84, 'different slots' n85, 'each a different count' n86), and n83's missed two subtitles that restate their titles. Of the three shapes cycle 16 named, only one recurred (n82's measure in pane titles, named and kept).
what: Skill and rule text for the skill findings of expression cycle 17: a read-aloud pass with no 'kept' line, a stated reference for every figure, a table view for a strip of five measures, phone columns that keep every answering column, readouts that carry every measure the parts draw, held pill slots and one empty cause, and the single lessons.

packages/basalt-ui/docs/bar-list.md (the `secondary` field, through gen-docs if generated)

change: (1) The read-aloud pass ends with every fact in one slot: its table has no 'kept' or 'on purpose' outcome, a second slot is cut or rewritten to say something new, and a reason is not a slot (n81 .3, n82 .11, n84 .23, n85 .32, n86 .41); add the shapes this cycle missed: a subtitle or caption sentence that restates the title or the marks (n83 .17, n84's two captions, n86 'Work first, then clean'), and a row that prints bar, share and amount at once (n83). (2) Stand every figure against the reference the data holds and name the base in the pill (n85 .28: '-8 pts vs 33 %'; n86 .37, P2: a cadence beside a last-run age is an overdue state, and a share of the whole is a `sub`, not a delta). (3) A strip of five or more measure cells is a grid of records: give it a table view or keep the strip at four (n82 .15, P2; cards.md:60 already says 'a measure'). (4) Phone columns keep every answering column in a card slot or the three columns, and a table whose cards fit one screen keeps its cards (n85 .31, n86 .40). (5) The focus readout carries every measure the parts draw, in the figure's period or status or a strip cell's sub (n84 .20: the rolling totals and the distance to the cap; n85 .30: no readout on the bar card). (6) Hold a pill's slot in loading and empty with the held-value `Delta`, and give one empty cause with one next step across the parts of a page (n82 .10, n84 .21). (7) Single lessons, each one case: a missing day is a gap and a caption, never a zero in a rolling total (n84 .18); a status column draws a mark per state with its icon (n86 .35); a stacked `BarList` row carries its counts in `secondary` (n85 .27; document `secondary` in bar-list.md); a value a 390 heat grid cannot print gets another carrier (n83 .16); a part at a grain no focus arm reaches joins, folds or drops (n81 .4, .5).
acceptance: The read-aloud pass has no kept outcome and names the new shapes with cycle-17 cases cited
The skill says a stated reference for every figure, the overdue state for an age against a cadence, and a table view for a strip of five measure cells
Lessons (4) to (7) are in the skill or its references with their cases, and bar-list.md documents `secondary`
